prompt: How many products make up the first 60% of the webshop's net revenue (store_code WEB-01) from 1 January to 30 June 2025 (UTC order dates, both days included)? Take the products from the highest revenue down; when two products have the same revenue, the lower product_id comes first. Count the products up to and including the first one at which the running revenue reaches 60% of the webshop's total. Return one column, n_products. The result is a single row. Any row order is fine.
hints: Next, give each product its running revenue from the top down and the webshop's total, then count.
A product counts when the running revenue before it is still below 60% of the total: its own running revenue minus its own revenue.
why_this_works: Ranked from the top, a product is needed while the revenue before it is below 60% of the total; counting those rows gives the 60% set.
